rules.statement: The ownership and possession of the field were established to belong to the temple, for which the plaintiff was the Viharadhipathy.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The evidence from the documents and grain tax receipts showed that the field was owned and possessed by the temple of which plaintiff was Viharadhipathy. (2) Although in view of section 26 of the Buddhist Temporalities Ordinance the mortgage of temple land is not valid yet the decree was entered against the plaintiff on his default by a Court of competent jurisdiction and it cannot be said that the decree and consequent sale at which the 2nd defendant bought are a nullity. The plaintiff was a party to the mortgage action and is bound by the decree and sale on it in view of the provisions of section 15 of the Mortgage Act. rules.statement: A plaintiff who defaults in a mortgage action and is a party to the proceedings cannot later challenge a decree and sale resulting from that default, as they are bound by the outcome.
